data.name: Dawn Girl
data.detailed_description:
Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world. The game combines intense survival elements and beautiful girl character settings, bringing unique visual enjoyment and profound emotional experience.

World background:

An unknown virus suddenly erupted and rapidly spread, infecting humans and turning them into zombies. And the world in which the player is located has already fallen, whether to wait for rescue or to adventure and explore for survival.

Follow the system:

The unique gameplay allows you to save NPCs and recruit them as teammates, but they will also be attacked and killed, requiring your protection.

Survival Challenge:

Faced with endless zombie threats, players need to survive in resource scarce environments, collect and manage resources, and respond to zombie attacks.

Emotionally driven storyline:

With profound plot and rich character interactions, players will explore the relationships between characters and experience the emotional bonds between life and death in the post apocalyptic crisis.

Exquisite visual experience:

It presents the doomsday world with exquisite anime painting style, combining beautiful environment and lovely character design to bring visual enjoyment to players.

Exploration of the Apocalypse:

Players can explore the post apocalyptic world, discover hidden secrets and resources, search for survivors to unlock new items and weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Dawn Girls "is a third person shooter game set in the early stages of a viral outbreak. Players using firearms to hit enemies will produce a red splash effect, and the game will feature female characters dressed in revealing clothing.
